notes: Read the full 102-line numbered source before editing. Web imports (L1-3): react-i18next useTranslation, lucide-react Rows/Rows3/Table2, and cn from @/lib/cn — none have a native parity surface (rule 4). useTranslation becomes a local fallback hook returning the inline English string (react-i18next is not in the native deps; same approach as the SourceLayerBadge/InlineCallout ports, density.* keys retained for i18n intent); the three lucide SVGs become decorative View-drawn glyphs (see L21-25 below); cn is dropped because RN has no className, so className (L12) is kept on props for source compatibility and destructured as _className, with a native style?:StyleProp<ViewStyle> added.

Density union type (L5) is ported verbatim. DensityToggleProps (L7-17: value L8, onChange L9, options L10-11, className L12, testId L13-14, ariaLabel L15-16) is ported with the same names; native-only style is appended. DEFAULT_OPTIONS (L19) ['table','compact','comfortable'] is ported byte-for-byte. The ICONS lucide map (L21-25) is replaced by the DensityIcon component: table->Table2 renders a 2x2 grid (two iconGridRow Views each with two gridCell fills), compact->Rows3 renders three dense bars (height 2, gap 2), comfortable->Rows renders two roomy bars (height 3, gap 4); each mirrors the lucide silhouette and is pointerEvents=none + lives inside a non-accessible button child (web aria-hidden, L95).

Component JSDoc (L27-34) is condensed into the native header + the function JSDoc, noting the radiogroup/arrow-key->increment/decrement mapping. The signature/destructure (L35-42) is ported (value, onChange, options=DEFAULT_OPTIONS, className->_className, testId, ariaLabel, +style). useTranslation()+labelMap (L43-48) keep the exact density.table/compact/comfortable keys and 'Table'/'Compact'/'Comfortable' fallbacks; groupLabel (L49) keeps ariaLabel ?? t('density.groupLabel','List density').

onKeyDown (L51-60): React Native View has no portable key event on touch, so the IDENTICAL wrap-around index logic is preserved in a `step(direction)` callback — options.indexOf(value) guard (L53-54, idx<0 returns), len=options.length, ArrowRight==options[(idx+1)%len] / ArrowLeft==options[(idx-1+len)%len] (L56-58), onChange(next) (L59). It is wired to the radiogroup's screen-reader increment/decrement adjustable actions (swipe up/down) via onAccessibilityAction + accessibilityActions, the native analog to the web arrow keys (documented as the keyboard-substitute; the literal ArrowLeft/ArrowRight pointer/keyboard affordance is unavailable on touch).

The radiogroup <div> (L62-73): role='radiogroup'->accessibilityRole='radiogroup'; aria-label=groupLabel->accessibilityLabel; data-testid=testId->testID; onKeyDown->onAccessibilityAction (above); tabIndex={-1} (web focus management) is dropped on touch. The cn container classes (L69-72) map to styles.group: inline-flex items-center->flexDirection row + alignItems center + alignSelf flex-start, gap-0.5->gap 2, rounded-md->borderRadius 6, border border-[var(--glass-border)]->borderWidth 1 + colors.border, bg-[var(--surface-1)]/40->rgba(14,23,39,0.4), p-0.5->padding 2.

options.map (L74-99): each <button> (L78-94) becomes a Pressable. type='button' is implicit; role='radio'->accessibilityRole='radio'; aria-checked=selected->accessibilityState={{checked:selected,selected}}; aria-label=labelMap[opt]->accessibilityLabel; tabIndex (L84, web focus order) dropped on touch; onClick=()=>onChange(opt) (L85)->onPress; data-testid=`${testId}-${opt}` (L86) preserved as testID with the same template. The button classes (L87-93) map to styles.option (inline-flex items-center->row+center, gap-1.5->gap 6, rounded->borderRadius 4, px-2 py-1->paddingHorizontal 8/paddingVertical 4, text-xs->AppText variant caption=12) with selected bg-[var(--surface-2)]/text-[var(--text-primary)]->#151621 + colors.textPrimary and idle text-[var(--text-secondary)]/hover:bg-[var(--surface-2)]/50->colors.textSecondary + pressed rgba(21,22,33,0.5); the focus-visible blue-500 ring (L89) collapses to the shared pressed-state styling.

Inside the button: <Icon className='h-3.5 w-3.5' aria-hidden /> (L95)->DensityIcon kind=opt color=tint sized 14x14 (h-3.5 w-3.5) and decorative. The label <span className='hidden sm:inline'> (L96)->AppText gated by useWindowDimensions().width >= 640 (Tailwind sm breakpoint) so the label only shows on wider native viewports, faithfully reproducing hidden sm:inline; selected/idle tint drives both icon and label color. Closing JSX (L97-101) and the component close (L102) are mirrored.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported (rule 4): only React, react-native primitives (Pressable, StyleSheet, useWindowDimensions, View, type-only AccessibilityActionEvent/StyleProp/ViewStyle), the existing apps/native AppText primitive, and the shared theme colors token (rule 5). Verified gates from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) passes, npm run lint -- --quiet passes (no errors), and npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles passes.
